caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object is metallic in appearance, rendered in a grayish-brown tone, and shaped somewhat like an elongated, rounded triangle with a flat base and a narrow stem extending from the bottom. Near the top center of the object is a cut-out star shape. Flanking the star, there are two similarly shaped cut-outs, symmetrical on both left and right sides, resembling elongated ovals. Below the star, in the center, is a heart-shaped cut-out. Additionally, on the lower half to either side of the heart shape, there are two smaller circular cut-outs. The narrow stem at the base of the main body ends in a circular opening. The artist's name, "Violet Hartenstein," is written in small, clear print toward the lower right of the paper. The overall composition is minimal, with the focus entirely on the central, symmetrical object.
title: Trivet
